title: 第1章 大帝修为第2章 收徒系统
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
【应读者老爷要求，现将前期境界置于第一章】
【前期境界：
炼体，通脉，灵台，元神，问心，天人，洞天，法则，尊者，通天（大能），逍遥（圣人），道境（明道（大帝）、融道（帝尊）、掌道（天帝））
道境之前每个大境界分为九重天九个小境界。
道境是多个大境界的统称，分为明道，融道，掌道，分别对应称呼大帝、帝尊、天帝。
最后明道、融道、掌道这三个境界，细分为前中后巅峰四个小境界，与前面十一个大境界划分不同。
【桀桀桀......】
【诸位彭于晏刘亦菲的脑子，本长老暂借一用！
玄尘大陆，东玄域。
道极宗，道阳一脉。
道阳峰后山，天朗气清，微风和煦，有位容貌俊朗的青年慵懒地躺在竹躺椅上，旁边有一小桌，些许灵果以及几杯灵汁置于其上。
秦天阳狠狠咬过一口灵果，再喝上一大口灵汁，正值阳光洒在身上，暖和极了，好不惬意。
他是上一任道阳一脉的脉主秦山河外出游历时在一个寒冬之日带回宗门的一个孤儿。
当时秦山河发现了以乞讨为生的秦天阳，探查到其根骨不凡，起了爱才之心。
于是将当时正值八岁的秦天阳带回了道极宗。
然而秦山河不知道的是，这个世界的秦天阳早已在被秦山河发现前一刻彻底冻死而去，取而代之的是从蓝星穿越而来的秦天阳。
“我在马路边，捡到一分钱。”
“把他交到警察叔叔手里边。”
“......”
秦天阳一边哼着歌一边翻个身，拿起一个灵果。

只见他，手一抛，灵果沿着一道优美的抛物线进入了嘴里。
鲜甜可口！
这才是生活！
想想他上辈子过的是什么牛马日子？
朝六晚十二！
二十年前，秦天阳还是一位已经踏入社会三年被现实生活狠狠压榨的牛马。
他在一家名不见经传的小公司上班，早上喝一杯勾兑豆浆加几个淋巴肉馅的包子，中午吃着国潮包装的拼好饭，晚上加班到十二点，回到充满甲醛的廉价出租屋，眼睛一闭，就是一天过去了。
不当人的资本家把他当牛马一样压榨着。
平时上班不见踪影的上司，只要你一摸鱼，就像是触发了某种诡异规则，瞬间到你身后。
大概是老天爷开眼了。
某一天，他在一次习以为常的加班过程中猝死了！
再次醒来发现自己穿越了。
现在身处异世，不需要上班，不需要加班，没有半夜领导的恐怖来信，好不快活。
除了吃就是喝！
什么？你说修炼？
content_en:
[At the request of the reader, the early stage is now placed in the first chapter]
[Early stage realm:
Refining the body, channeling the meridians, spiritual platform, Yuanshen, asking the heart, heaven and man, cave heaven, law, venerable, Tongtian (mighty), Xiaoyao (sage), Tao realm (Mingdao (Great Emperor), Rongdao (Emperor), Zhangdao (Celestial Emperor))
Each major realm before the Tao realm is divided into nine small realms of the Nine Heavens.
Dao realm is the collective name for multiple great realms, divided into Ming Dao, Fusion Dao, and Zhang Dao, which are respectively called Great Emperor, Emperor Zun, and Heavenly Emperor.
Finally, the three realms of Ming Dao, Fusion Dao, and Zhang Dao are subdivided into four small realms, the front, middle, and back peaks, which are different from the previous eleven major realms.
【Jiejiejiejie......】
[This elder can borrow your brains from Peng Yuyan and Liu Yifei for now!
Xuanchen Continent, Dongxuan Territory.
Daoji Sect, Daoyang lineage.
On the mountain behind Daoyang Peak, the sky was clear and the breeze was gentle. There was a handsome young man lying lazily on a bamboo couch. There was a small table next to him, with some spiritual fruits and a few glasses of spiritual juice placed on it.
Qin Tianyang took a bite of the spiritual fruit and drank a large sip of the spiritual juice. The sun was shining on his body, making it very warm and comfortable.
He was an orphan brought back to the sect on a cold winter day by Qin Shanhe, the previous leader of the Daoyang lineage.
At that time, Qin Shanhe discovered Qin Tianyang, who made a living by begging, and discovered that he had extraordinary abilities, and he developed a love for talents.
So Qin Tianyang, who was eight years old at the time, was brought back to Daoji Sect.
However, what Qin Shanhe didn't know was that Qin Tianyang in this world had completely frozen to death the moment before he was discovered by Qin Shanhe, and was replaced by Qin Tianyang who had traveled from Blue Star.
"I found a penny on the side of the road."
"Leave him in the hands of the police uncle."
"..."
Qin Tianyang turned over while humming and picked up a spiritual fruit.
I saw him, and with a flick of his hand, the spirit fruit entered his mouth along a beautiful parabola.
Sweet and delicious!
This is life!
Think about what kind of life he lived in his previous life.
Morning six to twelve!
Twenty years ago, Qin Tianyang was still a young man who had been severely squeezed by real life after entering society for three years.
He works in a little-known small company. In the morning he drinks a cup of steamed buns mixed with soy milk and a few meat fillings. At noon he eats Guochao packaged rice. He works overtime until twelve o'clock at night. When he returns to a cheap rental house full of formaldehyde, he closes his eyes and the day passes.
The inhumane capitalists exploited him like an ox.
Your boss, who usually disappears at work, is behind you instantly as if some strange rule has been triggered as soon as you touch a fish.
Maybe God opened his eyes.
One day, he died suddenly while working overtime as he was used to!
Woke up again and found that I had traveled through time.
Now I'm in a different world, I don't have to go to work, I don't have to work overtime, I don't have a scary letter from my boss in the middle of the night, I'm so happy.
In addition to eating and drinking!
What? You mean cultivation?
